title: Hearty Peruvian Chicken Wrap
description: A fresh and chewy Peruvian dish featuring milk chocolate and dashi extract, wrapped in a corn husk, this crowd-pleaser is high in protein and perfect for any meal.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers and onions

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together dashi extract, milk chocolate chips, and a pinch of salt.
Add the chicken to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through.
Warm the corn husks by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning cooked quinoa, roasted vegetables, and chicken onto a corn husk, and topping with feta cheese and cilantro.
Optional: drizzle with additional dashi extract and sprinkle with milk chocolate shavings.
